propositions: Comment triage cannot resolve size pressure in event_append.py (791/800) and _processors.py (777/800) because their comments are load-bearing replay-compatibility justifications.
Verified-stale comments in gitutil.py, llm_format.py, hlc.py, and _filters.py must be corrected in-place where they document live invariants or deleted where their referents no longer exist.

The wire-format changelog in _version.py:39-66 and docs/event-schema.md are duplicative; the canonical docs version must be completed with v4/v5 entries before the code copy is collapsed to a citation.

Four snapshot-restore migration guards at _processors.py:719-774 are highest-risk and must not be relocated, as their inline rationale is essential to prevent accidental unconditional execution that would clobber recorded channels.
The do_not_move entries must be recorded in .joe-janitor/tools.md before any edits land, with _processors.py:719-774 explicitly documented as the highest-risk block.
